idea-plugin.name: Git Workflow Enforcer
idea-plugin.description:
Git Workflow Enforcer

Enforces team Git workflow rules directly in your IDE — branch naming conventions, commit message format, merge policies, and more. Configurable via .git-workflow.yaml shared through Git.

Features

  • Branch naming — enforce Gitflow, trunk-based, or custom naming conventions
  • Commit messages — Conventional Commits format, JIRA key requirement, length limits
  • Merge policies — protect branches, require PRs, block direct pushes
  • Status bar — real-time compliance indicator
  • Pre-commit validation — catch violations before they happen
  • Team config — share rules via .git-workflow.yaml in your repo

Workflow Presets

  • Gitflow — feature/*, bugfix/*, release/*, hotfix/* branches
  • Trunk-Based — short-lived branches from main
  • GitHub Flow — feature branches with PR-based merges
  • Custom — define your own rules
